english.title: Fishing vessel owner fails to ensure a fisherman's work agreement satisfies requirements of regulation 9
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the owner of a fishing vessel, failed to take reasonable steps, prior to entering into a fisherman's work agreement with a fisherman, namely **(..SPECIFY FISHERMAN..), to satisfy itself that

(A)_[he]_
(B)_[she]_

had sufficient opportunity to review and take advice on the terms of and conditions of the agreement, had received an explanation of the rights and responsibilities of the fisherman under the agreement and was entering into the agreement freely
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 9(4) and 29(1) of the Merchant Shipping (Work in Fishing Convention) Regulations 2018.
